13. tests [tester] (after checkpoint_skill; runners acp -> claude-code; may only change test/**, package.json, stryker.config.json, specs/001-inventory-app/tasks.md)

17. verify [shell: npm install --no-package-lock --no-audit --no-fund && npm test] (after checkpoint_code)
18. acceptance [shell: node acceptance/inventory.mjs] (after verify)
19. mutation [shell: npx stryker run && node -e "const r=require('./reports/mutation/mutation.json');const s=[];let n=0;for(const[f,v]of Object.entries(r.files))for(const m of v.mutants){n++;if(m.status==='Survived')s.push(f+':'+m.location.start.line+' '+m.mutatorName)}require('node:fs').writeFileSync('reports/mutation/survivors.txt',[n+' mutants, '+s.length+' survived',...s].join(String.fromCharCode(10))+String.fromCharCode(10))"] (after acceptance)
20. final_review [reviewer] (after mutation; consensus with architect; may only change nothing)
   board: reads analyze, tests, implement (note, question, result, fact, decision), at most 4000 characters; may post nothing
